scores.evidence: Order: T1–T3 on day 1. T4, then T5 and T6, then T7–T11 ... then T12.
scores.rationale: Substrate (infra, DB, queue, gateways, policy) precedes triage, and resolution is gated on Spikes A/B/C before M2.

scores.evidence: triage running end to end in shadow mode on the real pilot repos, recording decisions but not posting them, deployed through the real pipeline.
scores.rationale: M1 is a real end-to-end slice through the production pipeline before resolution features.

scores.evidence: Key Decisions table with columns: Options considered, Reversibility, Revisit if (e.g. D3, D9, D12), plus assumptions with defaults.
scores.rationale: Irreversible choices are listed with defaults and explicit flip conditions, and assumptions have impact-if-wrong and validation.

scores.evidence: T4, then T5 and T6, then T7–T11 ... then T12; Policy Engine and gateways built before triage handler
scores.rationale: Widest-impact items (infra, schema, queue, gateways, policy, kill switch) come before leaf features, and spikes on riskiest assumptions run early.

scores.evidence: T5: sandbox security group with no egress rules; T7 HMAC verification; T11 kill switch, comment sanitiser; Spike C in M1
scores.rationale: Security has concrete treatment from M1 onward (HMAC, scoped tokens, policy engine, no-egress subnet) and in M2/M3.

scores.evidence: Observability (M1 logs and cost, M2 dashboards and alerts).
scores.rationale: Logs, traces and admin trace exist in M1, but dashboards and alerts are deferred to M2 and it's mostly a standalone section.

scores.evidence: Terraform the staging environment ... Migrations apply and roll back cleanly; pinned model versions in config; datasets in git
scores.rationale: IaC, migrations, pinned models and versioned eval data are present, but reproducibility isn't explicitly addressed per phase (e.g. lockfile drift noted as a gap).

scores.evidence: T8: 2 workers never claim same job, expired lease re-claimed, 4th failure lands in dead; Flows 3 and 4 shown by fault-injection tests in staging
scores.rationale: Idempotency, retries, dead-letter, reconciler and circuit breaker appear from M1, with fault injection in M2 and recovery tests in M3.

scores.evidence: Evaluation comes first ... Triage is one structured model call with no tools ... hard step, time, and spend limits
scores.rationale: Defenses, budgets, HITL and evals precede capabilities; the gateway comes before orchestration. Retrieval is minimal by design (no vector index) and memory is N/A, so the order is sound.

scores.evidence: Auto-attempt resolution for good_candidate issues (R2) | Merge rate ≥ 50% for 4 weeks on R1
scores.rationale: Deferred items are listed with concrete pull-forward triggers, plus deliberate shortcuts and non-goals.

note: A very strong plan with thin-slice shadow-mode M1, explicit decisions with flip conditions and deferred triggers. Its weaker points are observability (alerts and dashboards wait until M2) and reproducibility, which is not treated per phase.
